text: opened the forest of cardinals for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; group 1 (the B1c test found gates failing in t04, T3-037 against T3-098, and t06, watching and reporting the live canvas)
placed cardinals:t05 in T3-037 (also in T3-006, T3-050)

B1d room cardinals (order 424, group 1: the B1c test found gates failing in t04, T3-037 against T3-098, and t06, watching and reporting the live canvas) reread: A1 note, 9 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (17 threads, 175 lines, not cut). One change: t05 (attacking and joking with the Cubs logo) took T3-037 as a third kind beside T3-006 and T3-050, rule 0 line written (multiplacement_log 6,643 lines): c0091, a carrying code of the A1 note, judges r/place 'pretty much only made for tearing down other people's work and destroying instead of creating' while endorsing the attack. t04 (dismissing r/place: c0017 'I've decided I don't like /r/place', c0018 ''Tis a silly /r/place', c0072 steering clear of April Fools things) stays in T3-037: it judges the canvas, not the room's presence on it (T3-098); the T3-037/T3-098 discriminator is owed with glasgow t02. t06 (watching things move, and what survived after the close, c0022, c0074 to c0080, c0086) stays in T3-073, as france t09 at this leg. The rest hold: the Fanbot takeover (t01 T3-023 with T3-095), Cardinals and St. Louis marks (t02 T3-038 with T3-033 and T3-011; c0067 the r/stlouisblues representative starting the new logo), the witch hat, the pink bow and the Dolphins-Cubs alliance (t03 T3-010 with T3-195), removals (t07 T3-063 with T3-015), explaining r/place (t08 T3-016), the unseen Cubs-fan picture (t09 T3-050). Peripheral concepts named here: c0102, a member whose 'r/place glitched and gave me like 30 pixels in a row' to make the logo say cocks, near T3-088 (the T3-074/T3-088 glitch question); c0053, 'destroying the cubs logo and I feel like an absolute jerk', a qualm inside t05; c0064, Indians fans calling for help to destroy the Cubs logo, another room's call inside t05. No national or political content; the Cubs logo was turned into Cubsuck, Cucs, Cobs and Cocks (c0029, c0090, c0097, c0100). The A1 note's 'not this' holds as qualified at catch-up: members started and repaired a logo from h36 (c0024, c0035) before the r/stlouisblues representative's new spot (c0067). No new kind; the run is not reset.
opened the forest of FloydVsVoid for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; a contrary room

B1d room FloydVsVoid (order 454, contrary room) reread: A1 note, 15 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (134 threads, 550 lines, not cut). No change. The rule 0 lines and bag hold: rallying (t01 T3-002), specs and one schematic (t02 T3-070 with T3-091), the design and the trans flag and rainbow merger (t03 T3-004 with T3-056), Discords and a script (t04 T3-014 with T3-153 and T3-028), relocating three times (t05 T3-022 with T3-069), janitor work and helping the Swiss and Ireland (t06 T3-021 with T3-011 and T3-005), deals with the Void, the trans flag, the Swiss, Ireland, League and ROTMG (t07 bag under T3-010, including c0072 'I was wrong and should have compromised with the Void' and c0077 core defence for prism cover), the Void's taunts (t08 T3-050), reading the struggle (t09 T3-073 with T3-052), milestones and a former Void member's pride (t10 T3-009 with T3-072 and T3-163), chants and flying pigs (t11 T3-031), the founding post (t12 T3-043), what made the prism survive (t13 T3-157 with T3-027 and T3-043), giving up for Skeletor (t14 T3-181), bots (t15 T3-027 with T3-028). The T3-188 doing as a single concept in t04, not central to the Discord theme and not a carrying code (c0072, c0077, c0197): c0128, a member answering r/Ireland's 'Please stop invading the Irish flag' with 'many of our contributors arent on our sub or discord and thusly arent under our direct control' while restoring Irish pixels (c0129); the A1 note named the item under coder unsure. Peripheral: c0203, a copypasta poster threatening to remove the prism after the truce is refused, inside t07; c0196, the same poster's bots running overnight, in t15. Political content read plainly: '/r/the_donald would be more than willing to help' build The Wall (c0133), a joke inside t11; the trans flag taken under the prism and merged with the rainbow (c0006, c0011, c0020, c0032); the USA flag's loss condemned and its return celebrated (c0164, c0165); Ireland's pot of gold at the end of the rainbow (c0121, c0131, c0139); 'Please stop invading the Irish flag' (c0126). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the founder said they were wrong not to compromise (c0072), and the prism survived through deals with the Void, League, the Swiss and Ireland. No new kind; the run is not reset.
opened the forest of ChronoTrigger for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; group 1 (the B1c test found the gate failing in t02, T3-070 against T3-091, both naming templates)

B1d room ChronoTrigger (order 466, group 1: the B1c test found the gate failing in t02, T3-070 against T3-091) reread: A1 note, 7 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (45 threads, 247 lines, not cut). One change: t02 (keeping builders on the same guide and in the same thread) held T3-070 with rule 0 lines for T3-015 and T3-014; the reread found a fourth kind carried by concepts of its own, the old screenshot posted 'so people over here would be using the exact same image' (c0014, c0015, a carrying code of the A1 note), putting the room on one template (T3-091). By rule 0 it is now a bag: one placement in T3-070 (the references, the colour thread and the frozen frame, c0004, c0051, c0066), with T3-091, T3-015 (c0003, c0038, talk kept in the main thread) and T3-014 (c0025, c0043, Lucca planned in Discord) in the bag line (out/_analysis/b1d05_bags_ChronoTrigger.txt, checked with b1_precheck_bagfile.py and b1_check_bags.py). T3-015 and T3-014 were unplaced; the rule 0 writer wrote their two tier lines (tier_history 91 lines). The B1c failure is the T3-070/T3-091 discriminator, owed for B1e: sharing a template against holding everyone to one. The rest hold: the cast one sprite at a time (t01 T3-038 with T3-041 and T3-002), Marle's repairs before new sprites (t03 T3-005 with T3-021 and T3-004), borders with Waldo, Muse, the 76ers, Lucario and Kanye (t04 T3-010 with T3-150 and T3-061), help traded with EarthBound and Final Fantasy (t05 T3-151 with T3-011), thanks and accounts (t06 T3-009 with T3-043 and T3-073), the clone (t07 T3-054). Peripheral: c0091, a member who wasted pixels on a stale view of the canvas, inside t02. Political content read plainly: 4chan trolls using the trans flag's colours over the pixel art, and the trans flag room's warning answered with solidarity (c0007, c0008, c0011); Marle's sprite repeatedly drawn naked by trolls and dressed again (c0016, c0031, c0067, c0072, c0075). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: 'We had boundary alliances with everyone around us, so there was limited space with which to work' (c0083). No new kind; the run is not reset.

opened the forest of philippines for the second pass: B1d reads concepts and forests; group 2 (the B1b room note left for B1d: t07 T3-170 and t08 T3-079 in four concepts each, not named, and single-concept kinds in t03 to t12)

B1d room philippines (order 538, group 2: the B1b room note left kinds for B1d in t03 to t12) reread: A1 note, 12 second-order themes with every concept's words, and the forest whole (127 threads, 1,050 lines, not cut). No change. The rule 0 lines and bags hold: the room's own April Fools (t01 T3-001 with T3-023 and T3-095), daily talk (t02 T3-017), recruiting and explaining (t03 T3-002 with T3-016 and T3-074), one plan (t04 bag under T3-091), the canvas as war (t05 bag under T3-005), jokes (t06 T3-031 with T3-050), the flag, archipelago, Jollibee and heart (t07 bag under T3-065, 90 concepts), deals and repairs (t08 bag under T3-010, 104 concepts), what the work means (t09 bag under T3-080, 79 concepts), the red dot (t10 bag under T3-058), the finished canvas (t11 bag under T3-105), late arrivals (t12 T3-016 with T3-031 and T3-080). Kinds missing from existing bags, recorded here: t07 T3-170, mistaking friendly work for vandalism, in about ten concepts (c0236, c0247, c0248 'It's not an attack guys, we're drawing the archipelago'; c0249, c0406, c0442, c0445, c0447 'akala ko may umaatake', c0476, c0578) and T3-130 (c0370 'THEY REPRESENT PANATAG SHOAL AND PAGASA ISLAND IN THE KALAYAAN ISLAND CHAIN', c0461, c0462, c0163); t05 T3-022 (c0116, c0160, moving after OSU ate half the flag); t08 T3-079 (c0415, c0434, c0450, c0451, the unity heart with Iceland and the Faroes) and T3-194 (c0108, c0169); t10 T3-145 (c0531 'Because it is our flag', c0533), T3-121 (c0545) and T3-192 (c0409, a member promising a red dot on the sun 'for what a shitty country'); t11 T3-072 (c0487, c0490), T3-145 (c0572 Lupang Hinirang) and T3-130 (c0489). Single concepts: c0174 (Anonymous Philippines asked for help, near T3-084), c0034 (throwaway accounts, near T3-088), c0090 (a Chinese flag joke, near T3-142), c0095 and c0096 (the drug war as a joke, near T3-130), c0485 (a Katipunan flag, near T3-113), c0593 (a member recruiting trolls to ruin the room's own flag, near T3-192). National and political content read plainly: April Fools feints on Duterte (c0040, c0059, c0061), Robredo (c0043), Marcos and Martial Law and Mar Roxas and the Yolanda funds (c0056, c0057), a Mocha Uson takeover (c0036), 'No Dutertefication' (c0128, c0129); the wartime flag, red on the left, as the room's stance (c0099 to c0101, c0189, c0378, c0546 to c0551, c0416 to c0419, c0484); 'kung di natin maipagtanggol ang Scarborough laban sa mga banyaga' (c0054); Panatag Shoal, Pagasa Island and Benham Rise drawn and kept (c0370, c0461, c0462, c0426); China jokes (c0544, c0571); staying out of the OSU war likened to Duterte's China strategy (c0412); the red dot as a protest against the country, condemned (c0409, c0534); Jollibee as nationalism or marketing (c0275, c0302, c0303); 'EVERY FILIPINO SHOULD AND MUST HELP!' (c0052), PINOY PRIDE (c0397); Denmark against Sweden (c0132, c0138); politics set aside or kept out (c0168, c0468 to c0470, c0489). The A1 note's 'not this' holds: the room lost to OSU (c0165), voted to relocate (c0229), and repaired the smiley and FNaF art it had run over (c0232 to c0234). No new kind; the run is not reset.
